$Comment: The Headless Horseman on foot on the hard ride, once his hard fight throws him from the saddle: Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman written out again, as the game writes its own hard bosses, with more health, the hard name and his hard combat evaluator (CAE_Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_HM: a quicker dash and slam, and the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Hard_Mode effect that makes his swings, slam and dash hit harder). Like the normal role it stands on this pack's Hallows_Eve_Template_Horseman_Foot (the game's Gobliterator boss template, copied with his own sounds), so his dash keeps the same tell: half a second locked on, a second's glowing wind-up with a war cry, then a charge in a roar of flame that any block stops with a stun. He only exists inside his hard fight, swapped in from Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted_HM, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal the mounted role's. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
